ja442:1.1: Bahussuto sutadhammo si Saṃkha, diṭṭhā tayā samaṇabrāhmaṇā ca, ath' akkhaṇe dassayase vilāpaṃ, añño nu ko te paṭimantako mayā ti.
ja442:2.1: Subbhu subhā suppaṭimuttakambu paggayha sovaṇṇamayāya pātiyā bhuñjassu bhattaṃ iti maṃ vadeti, saddhā cittā tam ahaṃ no ti brūmīti.
ja442:3.1: Etādisaṃ brāhmaṇa disva yakkhaṃ puccheyya poso sukham āsasāno, uṭṭhehi, naṃ pañjalik' ābhipuccha: devī nu si tvaṃ uda mānusī nū 'ti.
ja442:4.1: Yaṃ tvaṃ sukhenābhisamekkhase maṃ bhuñjassu bhattaṃ iti maṃ vadesi pucchāmi taṃ nāri mahānubhāve: devī nu si tvaṃ uda mānusī nū 'ti.
ja442:5.1: Devī ahaṃ Saṃkha mahānubhāvā idhāgatā sāgaravārimajjhe anukampikā no ca paduṭṭhacittā, tav' eva atthāya idhāgatāsmi.
ja442:6.1: Idh' annapānaṃ sayanāsanañ ca yānāni nānā vividhāni Saṃkha sabbassa ty-āhaṃ paṭipādayāmi yaṃ kiñci tuyhaṃ manasābhipatthitan ti.
ja442:7.1: Yaṃ kiñci yiṭṭhaṃ va hutaṃ va mayhaṃ sabbassa no issarā tvaṃ sugatte, sussoṇi subbhuru vilākamajjhe kissa me kammassa ayaṃ vipāko ti.
ja442:8.1: Ghamme pathe brāhmaṇa ekabhikkhuṃ ugghaṭṭhapādaṃ tasitam kilantaṃ paṭipādayi Saṃkha upāhanāhi, sā dakkhiṇā kāmaduhā tav' ajjā 'ti.
ja442:9.1: Sā hotu nāvā phalakūpapannā anavassutā erakavātayuttā, aññassa yānassa na h' atthi bhūmi, ajj' eva maṃ Moliniṃ pāpayassū 'ti.
ja442:10.1: Sā tattha vittā sumanā patītā nāvaṃ sucittaṃ abhinimminitvā ādāya Saṃkhaṃ purisena saddhiṃ upānayī nagaraṃ sādhuramman ti
